verdict.rationale: GitHub explicitly markets PR review, code review, and triage as mobile features (github-mobile-docs-1, docs-4, docs-10), but hands-on reports describe real friction with that exact workflow—Android reviewers found diff lines wrap due to large fonts, per-commit review was hard to use, and no notification exists for PR review assignment (github-mobile-comm-4, comm-8), plus users wished the app better supported PR-comment-based review flow (comm-11). Missing for 10: recent (post-2020) independent verification that these UX issues were fixed, and confirmation that review works smoothly across both iOS and Android today.
